items.what: The plan stops with a proposal, which names its own route: Defect: the claim 'Commonplace currently counters bloat with five partial mechanisms' (Current answer) is unsupported as written and supports two readings. (a) Commonplace runs five practices or gates. (b) The KB holds five accounts that would counter bloat if applied. The readings lead to different conclusions about the query's retirement condition. The value-gate bullet itself says no value gate exists ('without a value gate, valid redundant artifacts still accumulate') and links an open query. The retirement-path bullet claims an 'operative retirement path' that Unsettled says lacks triggers. The scaffolding bullet cites a note that gives no retirement procedure. Correcting this restructures the Current answer section (separating operative practices from guiding theory, or moving bullets to Unsettled), so the passes cannot fix it. Reports: kb/workflow-state/data/current/review/results/kb/notes/how-do-we-fight-bloat-in-agent-produced-systems.md/kb/instructions/critique-note.md, kb/workflow-state/data/current/review/results/kb/notes/how-do-we-fight-bloat-in-agent-produced-systems.md/kb/instructions/composition-friction-gate.md, kb/workflow-state/data/current/review/results/kb/notes/how-do-we-fight-bloat-in-agent-produced-systems.md/kb/instructions/premise-decomposition-gate.md and kb/workflow-state/data/current/review/results/kb/notes/how-do-we-fight-bloat-in-agent-produced-systems.md/semantic/conceptual-role-conflation.md. Six further claim questions (C2-C7 in the assessment) also need claim changes: the rewrite evidence is misattributed, the additive bias is called empirical without evidence, the anchoring mechanism is stated as fact, content preservation under brevity pressure is not shown, the log conjecture needs a placement, and the page count is ambiguous. Together they leave few passages for passes. The role report shows no dependents. Route: commonplace-revise rewrite kb/notes/how-do-we-fight-bloat-in-agent-produced-systems.md --commission FILE, with the commission prepared with cp-skill-write-multistage. After the rewrite, re-review and run the text passes (fix-strategy-taxonomy on undefined terms, readability-and-flow on the brevity bullet and the Stakes thesis).
